claims.text: The driver's own GPS trace never places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at any point: the derived arrival block reports qualifying_fix_count 0 and longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec 0.0 across 98 driver fixes, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails and the fee is not chargeable.

Even measured against the driver's closest approach, the trace's min_distance_m is 53.84 m from the pickup pin — outside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius set by fee_schedule.arrival_radius_m — so there is no admissible arrival under POL-NS-02.

The effective in-geofence dwell is zero seconds against a required minimum of 180 seconds for this STANDARD zone class, a shortfall of 180 seconds, so under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full whether or not the rider was present.

The driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 08:11:35 and cancelled at 08:17:36, but the trace shows no in-geofence interval at all, so the waiting clock cannot have run from a qualifying fix; the driver's stationary position was outside the arrival radius and the fee is refunded in full under POL-NS-05.

The rider's own device track is present and stationary: 69 fixes, all at 0.0 kph, with a maximum distance of 13.59 m from the pickup pin — well inside the 100 m STANDARD rider_presence_radius_m — so the rider was at the pin throughout the waiting window.

The rider sent a coordinating message ('ok') at 08:13:05, read by the driver at 08:13:15, and the driver never replied in the chat log nor placed any in-app call before cancelling at 08:17:36 — the driver's only message was the bare 'here' at 08:11:55 — so POL-NS-04 limbs (a) and (b) are satisfied and the rider is exonerated.

The driver's own statement that he 'was right at the pin' is contradicted by his own trace, which places him no closer than 53.84 m and never inside the 50 m radius; the record, not the assertion, decides arrival under POL-NS-02.

The fare ledger shows the full SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged to the rider with refund_issued_sgd 0.00 and payment_status CHARGED, so the contested amount is live and a full refund of the cancellation-fee line is the remedy under POL-NS-06.

No traffic advisory covers this pickup road — EV-ADVIS-02744-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 — so POL-NS-06 limb (i) is unavailable and the driver cannot accumulate dwell across separate intervals or excuse the shortfall; the full refund stands.

The driver's profile shows no_show_terminations_30d of 2 against completed_trips_30d of 91, a rate of 0.022 — below the 0.08 threshold and below the count of 4 — so the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip and no escalation is warranted on that ground.

The rider's profile shows no_show_disputes_30d of 0 and disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0, and the driver's shows disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0, so neither POL-NS-09(c) nor POL-NS-09(d) is engaged and the case is decidable without human review.

claims.text: The driver's own GPS trace places him stationary at the pickup for the entire waiting window: his track shows a minimum distance to the pin of 53.84 m and a mean distance of 2702 m, but critically the derived arrival block records 98 driver fixes and zero qualifying in-geofence fixes — the driver never entered the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at any point. Under POL-NS-02 the driver is deemed to have arrived only where the trace contains at least 3 consecutive fixes within the arrival radius; here there are none, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails and the fee is not chargeable.

The driver's effective in-geofence dwell is zero seconds against a required minimum of 180 seconds for this STANDARD zone class — a shortfall of 180 seconds. POL-NS-06 makes the fee non-chargeable and refundable in full where the effective dwell is shorter than the free waiting period in force, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages. The rider is entitled to a full refund of the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee.

The driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 08:11:35 but the trace shows his minimum distance to the pin across the whole trip was 53.84 m — outside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius — and his mean distance was 2702 m. The arrival marker is therefore false under POL-NS-05: the waiting clock must be recomputed from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and since no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip, limb (ii) applies — the fee is refunded in full, no compensation is payable, and the trip is recorded as a false-arrival event against the driver.

The rider's own device was present and stationary at the pickup throughout: the rider track shows 69 fixes, all at 0.0 km/h, with a maximum distance from the pin of 13.59 m — well inside the 100 m STANDARD rider presence radius. The rider was at the pickup point waiting; the driver's failure to reach the pin is the sole cause of the failed pickup.

The rider sent a coordinating message ('ok') at 08:13:05, read by the driver at 08:13:15, and the driver never replied in the chat log nor placed any in-app voice call before cancelling at 08:17:36. Under POL-NS-04 the rider is exonerated and the fee refunded in full with no driver compensation where the rider sent a locating or coordinating message and the driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor called. The rider's presence within 100 m is established by the rider track, satisfying limb (c).

The fare breakdown confirms the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee was charged to the rider and remains CHARGED with zero refund issued. The fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01 because limb (b) fails (no in-geofence fix) and limb (c) fails (zero dwell against 180 seconds required), so the full SGD 4.50 must be refunded to the rider.

No traffic advisory covers the pickup road in this window — the advisory artifact is MISSING with weight 0.0. Under POL-NS-06 limb (i) a traffic advisory must be present and populated to permit separate in-geofence intervals to be summed; a MISSING advisory makes that limb unavailable. The driver cannot rely on any kerb restriction, enforcement, closure or accident to excuse the shortfall, and the full refund stands.

The driver's own profile shows 2 no-show terminations in the trailing 30 days against 91 completed trips — a rate of 0.022, below the 0.08 threshold, so the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip. But POL-NS-07 compensation is only payable where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not: limb (b) and limb (c) both fail. No driver compensation is owed on this trip.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02744 is refunded in full to the rider.

WHY THE FEE IS NOT CHARGEABLE. POL-NS-01 charges a no-show fee only if the driver reached the pickup point and held position for the free waiting period. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02744, weight 1.0, 100% coverage, no gaps) records 98 driver fixes whose closest approach to the pin is 53.84 m, with zero qualifying in-geofence fixes (qualifying_fix_count 0) and an effective in-geofence dwell of 0 s against the 180 s free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec; STANDARD arrival radius 50 m from fee_schedule.arrival_radius_m). The driver never entered the arrival radius, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails and limb (c) never starts — there is no dwell to measure. On the same figures the fee is made non-chargeable and refundable in full by POL-NS-02 (no qualifying in-radius fix) and by POL-NS-06 (0 s against 180 s, shortfall 180 s), which applies whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded.

THE DRIVER'S ARGUMENTS. (1) His statement that he 'was right at the pin' is contradicted by his own trace (53.84 m closest approach, never inside 50 m). A party's assertion does not decide arrival; POL-NS-02 decides it on the trace, and the trace is against him. (2) His POL-NS-05 argument — that the arrival marker is false and limb (ii) should record a false-arrival event — is rejected. POL-NS-05 catches a marker set where the trace places the driver more than 300 m from the pin or travelling at 15 km/h or more; the trace never places him closer than 53.84 m and never catches the marker at that distance, and POL-NS-05's own closing sentence directs that a driver stationary within 300 m of the pin but outside the arrival radius is decided under POL-NS-03, not caught by it. No false-arrival referral is produced. (3) His anti-farming point is correct but immaterial: POL-NS-07 pays compensation only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not, so no compensation is owed.

THE RIDER'S ARGUMENTS. The POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06 claims are accepted. The separate POL-NS-04 'exoneration' argument is rejected on its own terms: limb (a) requires a rider message that is locating or coordinating — an entrance, block, tower or bay identifier, a request for the driver's position, or a statement that the vehicle cannot be seen. The rider's only message is 'ok' (EV-CHAT-02744, sent 08:13:05); it is none of those, so limb (a) fails and POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate. The refund is unaffected because it follows from the driver's own evidence under POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06.

COMPENSATION. No driver compensation and no goodwill. POL-NS-07 requires POL-NS-01 in full. POL-NS-03's pin-ambiguity goodwill (50% of the fee) fires only where neither party named a sub-location AND trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 2 or more; the record shows 1 registered pickup point and neither chat message names a sub-location, so neither limb (i) nor limb (ii) of POL-NS-03 applies.

EVIDENCE WEIGHT. EV-ADVIS-02744-01 (traffic advisory) is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and can carry no fact; it carries no deciding fact here (the dwell falls short of the minimum on its own), and its absence merely makes POL-NS-06(i) accumulation unavailable, which changes nothing since there are no in-geofence intervals to sum. The deciding facts rest on EV-GPS-02744, EV-TRIP-02744 and EV-FARE-02744, all at weight_multiplier 1.0, so confidence is not capped below the 0.70 floor and is 0.90. The two claims asserting the missing advisory (one from each side) were discarded by the referee for non-disclosure of its impairment and are not relied on.

EXECUTION. A refund of SGD 4.50 does not exceed the SGD 8.00 execution threshold (POL-GEN-05), so it executes automatically on issue. Either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

ruling.explanation: The SGD 4.50 cancellation fee cannot stand and is refunded to the rider in full. The driver's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-02744, weight 1.0) never puts him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius of the pickup pin: the derived arrival block reports 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes and a longest qualifying run of 0.0 s across 98 fixes, and his closest approach on the whole trip was 53.84 m. POL-NS-02 therefore finds no admissible arrival, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the effective in-geofence dwell is 0 s against the 180 s free waiting period in force for this STANDARD trip (platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180) — a 180 s shortfall that makes the fee not chargeable and refundable in full under POL-NS-06, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she replied to messages. The charged figure is confirmed by the fare ledger (EV-FARE-02744, weight 1.0): cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, payment_status CHARGED. POL-NS-01 fails, so the full refund is the outcome and no fee stands. On the false-arrival argument: because the driver's stationary position lay outside the arrival radius but only 53.84 m from the pin, this is a POL-NS-03 wrong-position case, not a POL-NS-05 case. POL-NS-05 is engaged only where the 'arrived' tap places the driver more than 300 m from the pin or shows him travelling at 15 km/h or more, and this driver stopped within 300 m of the pin; POL-NS-05's own closing sentence routes such a driver to POL-NS-03. The requested false-arrival referral is therefore refused, and I add no referral of my own — no clause produces one on these facts (the POL-NS-01 driver-education referral fires only where the stationary fixes lie inside the radius, which they do not). The driver's statement that he 'was right at the pin' is contradicted by his own trace and is outweighed by it: arrival is decided by the record, not by an assertion. On compensation: POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full, so POL-NS-07 pays nothing, and the POL-NS-03 fault allocation also yields nothing — the rider never named an entrance, block or tower in the chat (her only message, 'ok' at 08:13:05, names nothing), so limb (i) does not apply, and the trip record carries only 1 registered pickup point, so the pin-ambiguity goodwill under limb (ii) (50% of 4.50 = 2.25) does not apply either. On the rider's POL-NS-04 argument: limb (c) is amply satisfied (69 rider fixes, all stationary, within 13.59 m of the pin) and limb (b) is satisfied (the driver did not reply within 120 s of 08:13:05 and placed no in-app call), but limb (a) requires a message whose content is locating or coordinating, and 'ok' is neither; POL-NS-04 therefore does not exonerate the rider. That does not change the outcome, because the refund is granted on POL-NS-02/POL-NS-03/POL-NS-06 independently of POL-NS-04. On escalation: the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (2 no-show terminations in 30 days against 91 completed trips is a rate of 0.022, below both the count of 4 and the rate of 0.08), so nothing is withheld and POL-NS-09(d) is not engaged; both profiles show 0 disputes between these parties in 90 days and the rider shows 0 no-show disputes in 30 days, so POL-NS-09(c) is not engaged; no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence in a way no clause resolves; and the trace is not impaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d) (max gap 0 s, 98 fixes, both tracks present, cancellation-fee line reconciles with the figure produced by resolution_rule), so POL-NS-09(e) is not engaged either. No traffic advisory is in evidence, so the interval-accumulation route in POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable; the full refund does not depend on it. Confidence is 0.90: the deciding facts — no admissible arrival and zero effective dwell, and the charge of SGD 4.50 — are carried by EV-GPS-02744 and EV-FARE-02744, both at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and nothing below it is relied on; the counterparty statement carries no weight multiplier and enters neither the minimum nor the maximum. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so the refund executes on issue.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02744 (EV-FARE-02744) is refunded in full to the rider.

Why the fee does not stand. The pickup at Blk 55 Lengkok Bahru is a STANDARD zone (EV-TRIP-02744), so the arrival radius is 50 m and the free waiting period is 180 s (fee_schedule.arrival_radius_m; trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180). POL-NS-02 deems the driver arrived only where the trace carries at least 3 consecutive fixes inside that radius. The driver's own trace (EV-GPS-02744, weight 1.0, complete, 98 fixes, 100% coverage, no gaps) contains zero qualifying in-geofence fixes; his closest approach to the pin over the whole trip was 53.84 m (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m). He never entered the 50 m radius, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails and the fee is not chargeable. Independently, POL-NS-06: the effective in-geofence dwell was 0 s against the 180 s required — a shortfall of 180 s — and that clause refunds the cancellation fee in full whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider answered messages. Because the driver's stationary position lay outside the 50 m radius but within 400 m of the pin, this is also the wrong-entrance case of POL-NS-03, which gives the same full refund.

Why no driver compensation. POL-NS-07 pays the driver only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full; it is not. POL-NS-03 allocates fault for compensation from the chat log, and neither of its limbs applies: the rider's only message was the bare 'ok' at 08:13:05, so no entrance or sub-location was named (limb (i) does not apply), and the trip record shows a single registered pickup point, not two or more (limb (ii) does not apply). No platform-funded goodwill is owed and no compensation is payable.

The parties' accounts. The driver's counter-statement that he 'was right at the pin' is contradicted by his own trace, which puts him no closer than 53.84 m and never inside the radius; the rider's account that the driver 'parked a bit away' matches the record. Under POL-NS-02 the measurement, not the assertion, decides arrival.

Claims rejected on their merits. ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 08-11-35 and cancelled at 08-17-36 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, and the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee was charged to the rider and remains CHARGED (EV-FARE-02744, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). The charge does not stand.

ARRIVAL AND DWELL. Under POL-NS-02 the driver is deemed to have arrived only if the GPS trace contains at least 3 consecutive fixes within the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius of the pickup pin. EV-GPS-02744 (weight_multiplier 1.0, no issue codes, 100% coverage, no gaps) reports 98 driver fixes, qualifying_fix_count 0 and a longest qualifying run of 0.0 s, and the driver's closest approach to the pin across the whole trip is 53.84 m - outside the 50 m radius. There is therefore no admissible arrival: POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails. The same zero measurement decides the dwell: effective in-geofence dwell is 0 s against the 180 s free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), a shortfall of 180 s, so under POL-NS-06 the fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present. POL-NS-06(i) accumulation cannot help the driver: it only sums separate in-geofence intervals, and here the shortfall is total. The MISSING traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02744-01, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) carries no deciding fact in this case and does not cap confidence; claims resting on it were discarded by the referee for non-disclosure and are not reinstated.

THE DRIVER'S ACCOUNT. The driver's statement that he 'was right at the pin' is outweighed by his own trace, which never places him inside the 50 m radius. The 'arrived' event is a driver-pressed marker (arrival_marker BUTTON, so POL-NS-12 does not apply); a status a party sets records only that the party set it, and POL-NS-02's arithmetic decides arrival.

POL-NS-05 AND THE FALSE-ARRIVAL REFERRAL. We do not find a false arrival marker within POL-NS-05. That clause fires only where the arrival timestamp places the driver more than 300 m from the pin or travelling at 15 km/h or above. The closest approach on the record is 53.84 m, and no reading shows him at 15 km/h or above at the marker; the clause expressly leaves a driver stationary within 300 m of the pin but outside the arrival radius to POL-NS-03. The driver's advocate's request for a POL-NS-05(ii) false-arrival referral is therefore rejected, as is the rider's framing of the refund as arising under POL-NS-05. The refund follows from POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06 whether or not that limb runs. In any event, on the alternative footing that the driver was stationary just outside the radius, POL-NS-03 refunds the rider in full with no driver compensation: the rider named no entrance in the chat log, so limb (i) does not apply, and registered_pickup_points is 1, not 2 or more, so the limb (ii) pin-ambiguity goodwill does not arise.

RIDER PRESENCE AND POL-NS-04. The rider was at the pin: the rider track (69 fixes, all 0.0 km/h) lies within 13.59 m of the pin, inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius. That is a fact, but it is not itself the ground of the refund - the driver's failure to reach the pin is. POL-NS-04 is rejected: it requires all three limbs, and limb (a) requires a message whose content is locating or coordinating (the sender's own position, an entrance/block/tower/bay, a request for the driver's position, or a statement that the rider cannot see the vehicle). The rider's only message is 'ok' at 08-13-05, which is none of those. Limb (b) is met (no reply within 120 s, no in-app call) and limb (c) is met, but without limb (a) the clause cannot exonerate the rider and adds nothing to the outcome.

DRIVER COMPENSATION. Nil. POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and limb (b) fails. The anti-farming check is not reached; in any case driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2 against 91 completed trips (rate 0.022), below both the count of 4 and the 0.08 rate, so no withholding and no escalation on that ground.

NO ESCALATION. Confidence is above the 0.70 floor; the trip record's button arrival and the GPS trace are not two measurements in direct conflict (a party-set marker is decided by the GPS test, so a clause resolves it); neither POL-NS-09(c) nor (d) is engaged (0 disputes between these parties in 90 days; 0 rider no-show disputes in 30 days); and no deciding fact rests on an artifact impaired under POL-NS-08(a)-(d).

CONFIDENCE. 0.90, capped by the artifacts that carry the deciding facts: EV-GPS-02744 (no in-geofence fix, dwell 0, closest approach 53.84 m) and EV-TRIP-02744 (arrival event, cancellation, fee in force), both at weight_multiplier 1.0 with no issue codes.

The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes on issue. The refund is of the cancellation-fee line only.
